ambiguities.text: The error message is described as being 'available to the caller in the returndata buffer and will also be copied to the output area' without clarifying precedence if output area is too small.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume return data buffer contains full error message while output area receives truncated data if out_size is smaller than actual return data length.

ambiguities.text: Stack underflow behavior is described as matching out-of-gas but exact gas consumption is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume stack underflow consumes all remaining gas, same as out-of-gas exception.

implicit_assumptions.description: Contracts using REVERT will properly encode error messages in a standard format (e.g., ABI-encoded Error(string)).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-standard error encoding makes error messages uninterpretable by callers, reducing debuggability.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BYZANTIUM_FORK_BLKNUM is reached before any contract relies on REVERT semantics.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts deployed before fork activation that use opcode 0xfd will get undefined behavior.
